title: R-DIS-38 is carried by the ladder story and by the re-list story, and the legacy story repeats the rule
source: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-38; legacy RWB-E4-022 AC2 and RWB-E4-026 AC2; FSD S5 A2.13 and A2.17; TSD S5 T4
section: s7 Acceptance criteria; s8 Business rules
description: R-DIS-38 (ROUND_OPEN, ROUND_CLOSED_NO_BID, bid_count = 0 and price_at_round above floor_price, step the price down and open the next round) is AC2 of both RWB-E4-022 and RWB-E4-026, and both features (FEAT-AST-13 and FEAT-AST-17) list the rule in the FSD. No source says whether the rule is evaluated once by the ladder step or once by the re-list step, or which story owns the write of the next round.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-022 AC2 and RWB-E4-026 AC2 carry the same Then lines; FSD S5 A2.13.3.1 and A2.17.3.1 both list R-DIS-38; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 has one R-DIS-38 row.
proposed: Keep the rule row single in rwb-decision and let RWB-S5-E4022 own the ladder step and this story own the no-bid outcome that opens the next round; declare the rule once in the contract baseline of RWB-S5-E4026-CON and record the duplicate for the assembler to close.

title: R-DIS-29 and API-S5-004 are carried by the pricing story and by the re-list story, and no source splits them
source: Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-29; FSD S5 A2.11 and A2.17; TSD S5 T-A.1 and T-A.2; Ownership Map
section: s7 Acceptance criteria; s12.1 REST operations provided
description: Legacy RWB-E4-026 AC3 applies R-DIS-29 (PRICE_PROPOSED, FLOOR_APPROVED_BY_OFFICER, officer_approved = Y, fix the floor as the reserve and set the step schedule by asset class, FLOOR_APPROVED), which FSD S5 A2.11 lists under FEAT-AST-11, the set-the-floor feature and its story. POST /assets/{assetId}/listings is documented as setting the list price and the floor and sending them for approval, while this story writes the next round and its price through the same operation. No source says which story publishes the operation or owns the floor approval.
evidence: FSD S5 A2.11.3.1 and A2.17.3.1 both list R-DIS-29; TSD S5 T-A.2 API-S5-004 purpose; legacy RWB-E4-026 Endpoints table.
proposed: Declare the operation and the rule once for the three stories; the pricing story owns the start price and the approval of the floor, the ladder story owns the step, and this story owns the no-bid re-list and the write of the reserve and the step schedule on an approved floor.

title: No column or reference row holds the re-list count, the re-list limit or the per-round price
source: TSD S5 T3.1 and T3.2; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-38 and R-DIS-44; FSD S5 A2.9 and A2.17
description: R-DIS-38 is conditioned on price_at_round above floor_price, and R-DIS-44 (which FSD S5 A2.9 lists for the re-appraisal and re-list cycle) is conditioned on relist_count below the re-list limit. The listing object of TSD S5 T3.1 carries id, asset_id, sale_channel, start_price, floor_price, round_no, listed_at and status only, and no source names a column, a table or a reference row for the round price, the re-list count or the limit.
evidence: TSD S5 T3.1 listing DF-SAL-001 to DF-SAL-008; TSD S5 T3.2 lists; Business Rules and Routing Logic v4 R-DIS-38 and R-DIS-44 rows.
proposed: Hold the round price against the round row the rounds story owns and the limit as versioned reference data, and record all three as placeholders of this service until the DB story or the LDM names a column.

title: No published operation name for the rwb-source-data asset and valuation product or for the rwb-case case-answer row
source: Architecture v5 slide 8; Ownership Map; TSD S5 T5.2 and T-A.1
section: s3 Preconditions; s12.2 REST operations consumed
description: The re-list step reads the asset class, the title status, the appraised value and the book value through rwb-source-data and answers ROUND_OPEN and FLOOR_APPROVED to rwb-case. No source document publishes the operation name of the rwb-source-data data-product read or of the case-answer row, and the C row of this slice in the plan is None.
evidence: Legacy RWB-E4-026 Endpoints table names only POST /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}/listings and GET /api/recovery/v1/assets/{assetId}; TSD S5 T5.2 names published Java interfaces without an operation name; the Ownership Map lists no source-data product or case-answer operation.
proposed: Declare both rows with the placeholder and their gap identifier, build against the documented shapes and their fakes on Day 1, and let P1 and P3 publish the names at the tag of RWB-S5-E4026-CON.

title: A re-listed round reaches the auction portals through no declared operation
source: FSD S5 A2.12 and A2.17; TSD S5 T5.1 INT-27; Ownership Map
section: s12.3 Events published; s19 Out of scope
description: FSD S5 A2.17 names the auction portals as an integration point, and a re-listed round changes the price and schedule that the publication of FEAT-AST-12 pushed to HOME.SCB and the portal. TSD S5 T5.1 records INT-27 HOME.SCB as not available today and published by the sale officer, and the Ownership Map gives S5 no portal publication operation; no source says how a stepped round is re-published or who owns the re-publication.
evidence: FSD S5 A2.17.2 Integration points; FSD S5 A2.12.3.1 R-DIS-33; TSD S5 T5.1 INT-27; Ownership Map operation list.
proposed: Keep the portal re-publication with FEAT-AST-12's story and its integration as a gap of this capability; the re-list step writes the round and answers the case and publishes nothing, so the portal gap cannot silently become a new event of rwb-asset.

title: REQ-S5-006 is mapped to FEAT-AST-08 in the traceability table while its text names the no-bid re-list
source: FSD S5 T8; FSD S5 Requirements served; TSD S5 T5.3
description: The requirements-served table of FSD S5 states REQ-S5-006 as 'Auction rounds run down the price ladder to the floor, and a round with no bid re-lists by rule', while the requirement traceability table T8 of the same document maps REQ-S5-006 to FEAT-AST-08 and maps no requirement to FEAT-AST-17. The story row of this slice carries an empty requirement list, so the trace is either REQ-S5-006 or no requirement at all.
evidence: FSD S5 Requirements served REQ-S5-006 row; FSD S5 T8 REQ-S5-006 to FEAT-AST-08 row; story rows of RWB-S5-E4026-APP and RWB-S5-E4026-CON with reqs [].
proposed: Trace the slice to REQ-S5-006 on its served text and to FEAT-AST-17, keep the T8 mapping correction for the FSD owner, and leave the PRD reference at Pending (C1).

title: The step evaluates the DISPOSAL package while DP-04 is outside the pattern set of the slice
source: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04; story row patterns DP03, DP05, DP13, DP19; TSD S5 T4
description: R-DIS-38 and R-DIS-29 are evaluated against the DISPOSAL rule package, which DP-04 governs with H RWB-PLT-E1072-CON and C RWB-P7-E1073-CON. The pattern set of this slice names neither, and no source says whether the package load is a capability of the service template or a pattern of this slice.
evidence: Template and Rules v1 R5.5 DP-04 row; the patterns of RWB-S5-E4026-APP; FSD S5 A2.17.3.1 rule table; TSD S5 T4.
proposed: Load the package in force through the service template, add no H row for the platform rules kit in this slice, and record the reading so the next realignment of the pattern set can confirm it.
